questions.question: Infrasonic sound waves have ______ wavelength compared to ultrasonic waves in the same medium.
questions.explanation: From v = fλ, for constant speed in a medium, wavelength is inversely proportional to frequency. Infrasonic waves (f < 20 Hz) have lower frequencies and thus greater wavelengths than ultrasonic waves (f > 20,000 Hz).

questions.question: If a sound intensity level is 40 dB, on a linear intensity ratio scale (I/I₀) it corresponds to a factor of:
questions.explanation: Sound level β = 10 log₁₀(I/I₀). For β = 40 dB, log₁₀(I/I₀) = 4, so I/I₀ = 10⁴ = 10,000.

questions.question: Sound travels fastest in which of the following media?
questions.explanation: Speed of sound depends directly on the medium's elasticity and density. In steel (solid metal), speed is ~5960 m/s, much faster than in water (~1480 m/s) or air (~343 m/s).

questions.question: The loudness of sound is most closely related to its:
questions.explanation: Loudness depends on the amplitude of vibration of the sounding body; greater amplitude produces greater sound intensity and loudness.

questions.question: The speed of sound in air on a warm day when outdoor temperature is 38°C is approximately:
Different musical instruments playing the same note with the same pitch and loudness can be distinguished due to their:
questions.explanation: Quality or timbre is the characteristic of musical sound that distinguishes notes produced by different instruments due to their waveform and overtones.

questions.question: A sound wave has frequency 2 kHz and wavelength 35 cm. How long does it take to travel 1.5 km?
questions.explanation: Speed v = fλ = 2000 Hz × 0.35 m = 700 m/s. Time t = distance / speed = 1500 m / 700 m/s = 2.14 s ≈ 2.1 s.

questions.question: The minimum distance between a person and a reflective obstacle to distinctly hear an echo in air at 20°C (v = 340 m/s) is:
questions.explanation: Persistence of human hearing is 0.1 s. Total round-trip distance 2d = v × t = 340 × 0.1 = 34 m, so distance d = 17 m.

questions.question: Compared with a sound of 60 dB, a sound of 80 dB has an intensity that is ______ times greater.
questions.explanation: Difference Δβ = 80 - 60 = 20 dB. An increase of 20 dB represents an intensity ratio of 10^(20/10) = 10² = 100 times.

questions.question: The pitch of a sound has a direct relationship with its:
questions.explanation: Pitch is the psychological sensation of sound that depends directly on frequency; high frequency corresponds to a shrill/high pitch.

questions.question: The SI unit of sound intensity is:
questions.explanation: Sound intensity is power per unit area (I = P/A), so its SI unit is Watts per square meter (W m⁻²).

questions.question: A doctor counts 72 heartbeats in 1 minute. The frequency of heart vibrations is:
questions.explanation: Frequency f = number of beats / time in seconds = 72 / 60 s = 1.2 Hz.
